definitions.explanation: A condition in which the arch of the foot is flattened so that the entire sole makes contact with the ground. Can cause discomfort when walking or running.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{扁平足|へんぺいそく}だった。
examples.english: I've had flat feet since childhood.

examples.japanese: {扁平足|へんぺいそく}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧やすい。
examples.english: With flat feet, you get tired easily when walking for a long time.

examples.japanese: {扁平足|へんぺいそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インソール→インソール：25739_insooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started using insoles to improve my flat feet.

notes:
Compound of {扁平|へんぺい} (flat; flattened) + ⟦{足|そく}→足：00992_soku⟧ (foot). A medical/anatomical term also used in everyday conversation about foot health and shoe fitting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扁平足|へんぺいそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{矯正|きょうせい}→矯正：14784_kyousei⟧: correction of flat feet
- {扁平足|へんぺいそく}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦インソール→インソール：25739_insooru⟧: insoles for flat feet
- {扁平足|へんぺいそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person with flat feet
- {扁平足|へんぺいそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve flat feet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外反母趾|がいはんぼし}: bunion; hallux valgus — another common foot condition
- ⟦{土踏|つちふ}まず→土踏まず：08543_tsuchifumazu⟧: arch of the foot — the part that is flattened in {扁平足|へんぺいそく}
- {偏平|へんぺい}: flat; flattened — the adjective form of the same kanji, sometimes written with this variant
